title.value: Dynamics of SGD with Stochastic Polyak Stepsizes: Truly Adaptive Variants and Convergence to Exact Solution
title.justification: The title is chosen because it summarizes the focus of the paper: the study of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with stochastic Polyak stepsizes and its convergence properties.
title.quote: Title: Dynamics of SGD with Stochastic Polyak Stepsizes

extractions.description: The paper explores the dynamics and convergence properties of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with stochastic Polyak stepsizes (SPS) and introduces new variants to address issues faced in non-over-parameterized regimes. The study investigates these variants for solving general convex optimization problems, and introduces DecSPS as a novel modification that ensures exact convergence. The paper provides theoretical solutions to the challenges and supports these findings with experimental results.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on optimization methods in machine learning, with no direct link to climate or ecological sustainable development outcomes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this work, we study the dynamics and the convergence properties of SGD equipped with new variants of the stochastic Polyak stepsize and provide solutions to both drawbacks of the original SPS.
